items.title: Betty Lee Hanson, Joe James, George Lewis, Joe Lewis, Joe Butler, Kid Thomas Valentine, Bill Russell, Allan…
items.q: People like Jim Robinson, George Lewis, Kit Howard, I mean...

ctx.x: How did you get hold of these men in the first place? Did they find out about you?
Well, these men are, you know, live here. Yeah. And a lot of them are quite famous. People like Jim Robinson, George Lewis, Kit Howard, I mean...
Excuse me for interrupting you here, Alan, but you said George Lewis. Now Lewis has just returned from Europe. How do you get him to come back here and play a one-night or a two-night stand?

items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: No, you made the ones with Bill, but we made the ones with Rudy.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. And I made a recording, then the next recording I made with Bill Russell.
Mm-hmm. No, you made the ones with Bill, but we made the ones with Rudy.
Oh yeah, of course. Oh yeah, yeah. Yeah, that's right. Yeah, I sure did.
